summary: English and Bangla first-party discovery identified Bangladesh DLRS/Online Land Record and Survey Management and the official Gangachara Upazila Land Office. The current public viewer exposes hierarchy, administrative boundary, per-sheet GeoJSON, and parcel vector-tile routes. Rangpur hierarchy and district-boundary requests worked, but the public survey-to-upazila lookup returned no rows and bounded candidate parcel metadata was empty. No safe Gangachara parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified; no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, response outcomes, current JavaScript routes, schema/CRS checks, field mapping, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-2284-gangachara.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
